description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting Standards - SLFRS9 - Finanacial Instruments (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the adoption and publication of a new accounting standard (SLFRS 9: Financial Instruments) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for financial reporting, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
